full_prompt_en: A square architectural graphic illustration presents a compact, geometrically simplified orange building isolated against a warm cream paper background. The background is almost empty, with a faint printed grain that makes its pale tone feel tactile rather than digital white. The building sits across the lower half of the frame, leaving wide breathing room above. Its main volume has a yellow-orange facade beneath a dark teal pitched roof, while red rectangular additions extend to the left and right. A tall red chimney rises along the right side and nearly reaches the upper quarter of the image. At the center-right, a narrow blue-green glazed bay forms a vertical strip, and a small dark entry sits beneath a low overhang. The left wing combines square windows and a stepped brick-red outline, with a slender exterior stair and rail crossing the front. The building is viewed at a slight angle so front and side planes are both visible, but the perspective remains diagrammatically calm. Fine black and dark-blue outlines define roof edges, windows, and the base, while small parallel marks suggest brick and surface texture. Warm orange and red planes meet cool teal in abrupt, clean color divisions. Light is flat and even, with just a few shaded planes to distinguish depth rather than dramatic cast shadows. The bottom rests on a thin gray ground line, avoiding a detailed environment. The overall composition treats the structure as a carefully balanced arrangement of geometric color, line, and open paper.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑图形插图把一座紧凑且几何简化的橙色建筑独立放在暖奶油色纸张背景前。背景几乎空白，淡淡印刷颗粒使浅色带有触感，而非数字白。建筑横置于下半幅，上方留下宽裕呼吸空间。主体体量在深青蓝坡屋顶下有黄橙立面，红色矩形附加部分向左右伸出。一根高红烟囱沿右侧升起，几乎抵达画面上四分之一处。中央偏右，一道狭窄蓝绿玻璃窗带形成竖条，低檐下有小深色入口。左翼结合方窗和阶梯状砖红轮廓，一段细外楼梯及扶手横过正面。建筑以轻微斜角呈现，正面和侧面都可见，但透视仍保持图解般平静。细黑与深蓝轮廓界定屋顶边、窗户和基座，细小平行笔画暗示砖块与表面肌理。暖橙红平面与冷青绿以突然而干净的色界相接。光线平坦均匀，仅以少数阴影平面区分纵深，而没有戏剧性投影。底部落在一条细灰地线上，避免复杂环境。整体构图把结构视作几何色彩、线条和敞开纸面的精心平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has a printed graphic finish, using clean geometry, fine outlines, and lightly textured flat color. Burnt orange, brick red, warm yellow, deep teal, and cream form a bold but limited palette. Large opaque planes meet at crisp boundaries, while small parallel marks and a faint paper grain soften their mechanical clarity. Vertical accents and low horizontal blocks create an orderly asymmetry. Lighting is even and diagrammatic, with only restrained value steps giving shallow depth. A compact lower grouping sits in abundant unmarked space, making color proportions and contour relationships easy to read. The overall effect is playful, rigorous, and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有印刷图形质感，运用干净几何、细轮廓和轻带肌理的平面色。焦橙、砖红、暖黄、深青绿与奶油色构成鲜明而有限的色域。大块不透明平面以清晰边界相接，细小平行笔画和淡纸纹柔化其机械般清楚。竖向强调与低矮水平色块形成有序的不对称。光线均匀且图解化，仅以克制的明度台阶给予浅纵深。紧凑的下方组合置于大量未标记空间里，使色彩比例与轮廓关系易于辨读。整体效果俏皮、严谨且可触。
theme_en: A geometric orange building isolated on a cream background
theme_zh: 奶油色背景上独立的几何橙色建筑
name: Robert Venturi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
